rows.text: Liquid AI just released two open-weight models for making decisions directly on your device. d1-3B handles text and images. The experimental d1-omni-600M adds image or audio input at just 600M parameters. A camera can flag a defect or a device can route a voice command locally, without a cloud round trip. Faster responses, less data leaving the device, and weights you can fine-tune yourself. Pretty cool for small, practical AI systems :)
rows.quoted: Today we release Open d1: two open-weight multimodal models in our d1 decision model family. > d1-3B: text + vision > d1-omni-600M: text + image or text + audio > Real-time decision making anywhere, from data centers such as @nvidia DGX to RTX workstations to Jetson at the edge. 1/
